fieldValues.title: RFC-011 containerScope explicit already conflated direct and effective membership before RFC-034
fieldValues.summary: render_service SectionSource::DiscoveryQuery containerScope: Explicit routed through the same list_members_degraded/list_members helper as Subtree, which (pre-RFC-034) computed rootInstanceIds/memberInstanceIds plus everything reachable by transitive contains-Relation traversal. So explicit scope was never actually shallow: it silently returned the same deep set subtree would once subtree traversal shipped. Fixed in srs-rust#970 by giving explicit its own list_direct_members path; a dedicated render_service test (render_subtree_scope_descends_into_declared_children_explicit_does_not) pins the two scopes apart for the first time.
evidence: crates/srs-repository/src/render_service.rs pre-fix: both ContainerScope::Explicit and ContainerScope::Subtree branches called list_members_degraded (i.e. container_service::list_members) with no distinct direct-only path

container_service::member_ids (pre-fix) already implemented I-66 condition 3 (contains-Relation traversal from rootInstanceIds), so any container with a contains edge out of a root had that target silently included even under containerScope: explicit
